lyrics: Murahara nagadhara Mukundha maadhava - Garuda gamana pankajanaabha
Parama purusha bhavabhandha vimochana - naramruga shareera namo namo
Jaladhi shayana ravichandra vilochana - Jalaruha bhavanutha charaNayuga
balibandhana gopijana vallabha - naLinodarathe namo namo
Aadhideva sakalaagama poojitha - yaadhavakula mohana roopa
vedoddhara srivenkata naayaka - naadhapriyathe namo namo
jala dhisha ya na ra vi chandra vi lo cha na
aa dhide va sa ka laa ga ma poo ji tha
Jala ru ha bha va nu tha cha ra Na yu gaa
yaa dhava ku la mo ha na roo paa
bali ban dha na go pi val la bha
ve dodh dha ra sri ven ka ta naa ya ka
naLi no dha ra the na mo na mo na mo
naa dha pri ya the na mo na mo na mo
